text: Here is how the owner builds an estimate from a saved package.
The owner starts a new estimate and picks the customer, Ridgeline Plumbing and Heating. Then they add Unit 14, one of the customer's vans.
They add the Full wrap saved package, and every material and labor line fills in at once: film, laminate, ink, supplies, design and installation. Then they do the same for Unit 17.
Each line shows what it costs the shop, what the customer pays, and the margin. The totals for the whole estimate add up on the right.
Unit 17 is a longer van, so it needs more film. The owner changes the amount, and the price updates. Every line can be changed.
